videos.headline: USC gets early score with Tahj Washington TD
videos.description: Caleb Williams flips it to Tahj Washington for the score as USC goes up 7-0 on the opening drive.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_OnePlay (USC gets early score with Tahj Washington TD) 2022/11/26 ESHEET

videos.headline: USC comes up with 4th-down stop
videos.description: USC comes up with a stop on fourth-and-1 to take over on downs.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_OnePlay (USC comes up with 4th-down stop) 2022/11/26 ESHEET

videos.headline: Michael Mayer hauls in TD catch for the Irish
videos.description: Michael Mayer tops off an 80-yard drive for Notre Dame with a touchdown catch as the Fighting Irish cut it to 10-7.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_OnePlay (Michael Mayer hauls in TD catch for the Irish) 2022/11/26 ESHEET

videos.headline: USC capitalizes on fumble recovery with TD
videos.description: Jack Pine turns it over on a handoff exchange and Raleek Brown takes it for a touchdown on the ensuing drive as USC goes up 24-7.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_OnePlay (USC capitalizes on fumble recovery with TD) 2022/11/26 ESHEET

videos.headline: Caleb Williams uses his legs on USC touchdown drive
videos.description: Caleb Williams makes a highlight-reel run for a gain of 19 yards and then tops it off with the touchdown run as USC extends its lead.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_OnePlay (Caleb Williams uses his legs on USC touchdown drive) 2022/11/26 ESHEET

videos.headline: Logan Diggs' TD gives Notre Dame a quick response
videos.description: Logan Diggs takes it for the score as Notre Dame gets a quick response to cut it to 31-21.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_OnePlay (Logan Diggs' TD gives Notre Dame a quick response) 2022/11/26 ESHEET

videos.headline: Caleb Williams tops off USC INT with TD run
videos.description: USC forces an interception and Caleb Williams rushes for his 3rd touchdown of the night as USC extends its lead to 38-21.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_OnePlay (Caleb Williams tops off USC INT with TD run) 2022/11/26 ESHEET

videos.headline: Michael Mayer snags 2nd TD for Notre Dame
videos.description: Michael Mayer snags his second touchdown of the game as Notre Dame cuts it to 38-27.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_OnePlay (Michael Mayer snags 2nd TD for Notre Dame) 2022/11/26 ESHEET

videos.headline: Caleb Williams stamps Heisman bid with impressive performance
videos.description: Caleb Williams throws for one touchdown and rushes for three in a impressive performance as USC defeats Notre Dame 38-27.

tracking.trackingName: COM_NCF Highlight (Caleb Williams stamps Heisman bid with impressive performance) 2022/11/26 ESHEET
